invariants.contract: GET matchall answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin user (also with update permission) and without library access, 404 for an unknown library and 400 for an invalid limit before the admin check; no task starts, no provider is asked and no book changes.

GET matchall of a book library without items answers 200 and emits task_started (library-match-all with the library id, title, translation key and substitution) and task_finished marked failed with the error 'No items found' to every authenticated socket.
GET matchall of a podcast library answers 200 and starts no task, so no task event and no change follow.

GET matchall of a library with a custom provider asks the provider once per item (mediaType, title, author), fills the metadata the books lack (narrators, publisher, year, description, genres, tags, language, isbn, asin, series) while keeping the existing title, writes the item metadata file, emits item_updated per item to users with library access, series_added, and a task_finished with updated 2.

A second matchall asks the provider again but changes nothing and emits no item_updated (details are only filled when missing); with skipMatchingMediaWithAsin or skipMatchingMediaWithIsbn the items that have an asin or isbn are not asked at all; every run ends with a finished task.
